information_at_origin: UTC day t has closed; use observations through t only
label_rule: origin+h must be within its stage; labels used for fitting/calibration must be observed

additional_models_status.attention: original notebook archived; audited export required

attention_selection.selection_metric: validation mean relative MAE across horizons
attention_selection.feature_status: freeze exact causal feature set in amendment before model comparison

mase_denominator: one-day absolute Low differences fitted on initial training only

intervals.feedback_rule: origin_j + h <= current_origin; never pool horizons
intervals.quantile_rule: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))-th score; infinity when rank exceeds n

volatility.target: Low-to-Low log changes, not close returns

statistics.primary_family: ACI normalised versus rolling normalised interval score: four horizons x two levels
statistics.dm_hac_lags: max(h-1, floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9))); Bartlett weights; sensitivity required

prospective.status: candidate window; full-study freeze required before 2027-02-01
prospective.eligibility: design tag published before start; BTC snapshot locked; stages A-D frozen before start
prospective.late_completion_rule: if A-D are not frozen before start, publish amendment and a new future window; never backdate
prospective.stop_rule: single endpoint evaluation after all daily outcomes through end have closed
